scripts.text:
[Belljamin Button]
The monsters here are able to control time.
Time, memories, environments... all can become warped here.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾賈明·巴頓]
這裡的魔物能夠操控時間。
時間、記憶、環境...在這裡都會扭曲。

scripts.text:
[Belljamin Button]
The monsters here are able to control time.
Come back when you've reached ^0000FFLevel 150^000000.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾賈明·巴頓]
這裡的魔物能夠操控時間。
請等到您達到^0000FF150級^000000再來。

scripts.text:
[Belljamin Button]
I'm begging you not to ask more about it. It might put your life in danger.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾賈明·巴頓]
我求您不要再多問了。這可能會危及您的生命。

scripts.text: Don't ask
scripts.translation: 不再多問

scripts.text: Go to 2nd floor of warped tower
scripts.translation: 前往扭曲塔二層

scripts.text: Go to 3rd floor of warped tower
scripts.translation: 前往扭曲塔三層

scripts.text:
[Belljamin Button]
Be careful with your choice.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾賈明·巴頓]
請謹慎做出選擇。

scripts.text:
[Belljamin Button]
I need ^0000FF10,000z^000000 to let you in. It's a pretty dangerous place to be.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾賈明·巴頓]
我需要^0000FF10,000z^000000才能讓您進去。那裡非常危險。

scripts.text: Quit
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text: Pay 10,000z
Why do you need money?
scripts.translation: 為什麼需要錢？

scripts.text:
[Belljamin Button]
Really? You don't have the money and asked me to take you there?
scripts.translation:
[貝爾賈明·巴頓]
真的嗎？您沒有錢卻還讓我帶您去那裡？

scripts.text:
[Belljamin Button]
I'm not sure how you'll keep track of time in there but be as careful as you can.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾賈明·巴頓]
我不確定您在那裡如何把握時間，但請務必小心。

scripts.text:
[Belljamin Button]
I am here all day for the safety of adventurers. I always alert them about the danger. That's why I need some form of payment.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾賈明·巴頓]
我整天都在這裡保護冒險者，也會不斷提醒他們這裡的危險。所以我才需要收取一些費用。

scripts.text:
[Belljamin Button]
Phew...You've made a good choice. This place is brutal so you should probably get back to a safe area.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾賈明·巴頓]
呼...你選得很明智。這裡兇險異常，最好儘快回到安全的地方。

scripts.text:
[Belljamin Button]
Perhaps you've seen me before?
scripts.translation:
[貝爾賈明·巴頓]
也許您以前見過我？

scripts.text:
[Belljamin Button]
You saw me in a different place, with a different look.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾賈明·巴頓]
你曾在別處見過我，那時我的模樣也不同。

scripts.text: Who are you?
scripts.translation: 你是誰？

scripts.text: Get me out of here!
scripts.translation: 帶我離開這裡！

scripts.text:
[Belljamin Button]
Can you explain to me what you've seen, what you've done?
scripts.translation:
[貝爾賈明·巴頓]
您能告訴我您看到了什麼，做了什麼嗎？

scripts.text:
[Belljamin Button]
Me too. You might also be a missing one. Unaware, with no purpose nor idea.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾賈明·巴頓]
我也是。你或許也是一個迷失者，渾渾噩噩，不知目的，也不知所求。

scripts.text:
[Belljamin Button]
It's time to go back. Please cherish your time some more.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾賈明·巴頓]
該回去了。請好好珍惜剩下的時間。

scripts.text: Stay a little bit more
scripts.translation: 再多待一會兒

scripts.text: Please take me back
scripts.translation: 請帶我回去

scripts.text:
[Belljamin Button]
You must really like this place. Well, do whatever you want.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾賈明·巴頓]
看來您真的很喜歡這裡。好吧，隨您便。

scripts.text:
[Belljamin Button]
It's time to move on. Do you have a favorite drink?
scripts.translation:
[貝爾賈明·巴頓]
該繼續前進了。你喜歡喝什麼飲料嗎？

scripts.text:
[Belljamin Button]
Think about the drink in a cup. Slowly stir the cup with a spoon and peer through as the drink changes color.
scripts.translation:
[貝爾賈明·巴頓]
想像一下杯中的飲品。用勺子慢慢攪拌，透過杯子觀察飲品顏色的變化。
